topic: Winter muscle aches and pain relief options (snow shovelling season)
headline: Snow season?
intro: Cold weather and shovelling can leave muscles sore. We can help you pick the right relief.

points.title: Warm up before shovelling
points.body: Stretch and move for a few minutes first. Cold, tight muscles are easier to strain.
points.tip: Push snow when you can, don't lift it.

points.title: Pick heat or cold
points.body: Cold packs are often used for a fresh strain; warmth can comfort stiff, achy muscles. Ask us which fits.
points.tip: Wrap packs in a cloth, never on bare skin.

points.title: Try a topical rub
points.body: Muscle rubs, creams and sprays go right where it aches. Read and follow the label.

points.title: Check before you combine
points.body: Pain relievers and cold and flu products can share ingredients. Ask our pharmacist before mixing.
points.tip: Ask us about your other medications.

cta_body: Our pharmacists are happy to help you choose.
